versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Hopkin Paid Ads skill.

- Enables querying ad platform data (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, Reddit) via the Hopkin CLI.
- Read-only: exclusively retrieves data—cannot create or modify campaigns.
- Provides usage instructions for installation, setup, authentication, and querying advertising data.
- Supports multiple output formats (JSON, CSV, TSV) and advanced filtering options.
- Guidance included for command discovery and troubleshooting.
